masking: [NAME] person, [ORG] company or product, [EMAIL], [PHONE], [DATE] absolute date, [IMAGE] inline image. Weekday words and relative times kept because the engine reads them.
labels_note: Labels were assigned by a model reading the real text and are NOT checked by the owner. Every number is "agrees with a careful model on real text". n is tiny. These sentences are evaluation only: do not train on them.

source_kinds.real_other: written by another real person (customer, prospect, auto-responder)
source_kinds.real_own: written by the owner's side for real business
source_kinds.dogfood_test: written by the owner or his agents as a product test; report separately, never mix into real recall

label_map: ASK / PROMISE / SILENT are the shipped pipeline (unsure, INFORM and ACK count as SILENT: no loop). HOLD / CLOSE are classifyReply on a waiting loop (closed, paid and declined are CLOSE; every other outcome holds). direction incoming vs own is who wrote the sentence. dogfood_test is never mixed into the real-only line.

cases.context: incoming reply to the owner's open ask
cases.text: רק היום חזרתי מחופשת החג – מקווה לשלוח לך משהו יותר מפורט במהלך השבוע.
cases.label: HOLD
cases.expected: HOLD: the owner's ask stays open (Waiting on). It is the other person's hedged promise with a this-week horizon; must not close the loop.

cases.context: owner's reply
cases.text: תודה, ושמחים שחזרת. מחכים לפירוט כשיהיה לך נוח.
cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: SILENT: no new loop and no card; the existing Waiting-on loop stays open.

cases.context: incoming, addressed by name to a third-party colleague; the owner is also in To
cases.text: עדכני אם משהו לא נראה לך או אשרי כדי שאתן ל[NAME] מחברת [ORG] אור ירוק.
cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: SILENT for the owner: the imperative is addressed to a colleague (feminine singular, named greeting), not to the owner. No Do It card.

cases.context: incoming, aside addressed to the owner
cases.text: ([NAME], במקביל עדכן גם אתה אם זה לא מפורט מספיק לצורך ההדגמה)
cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: SILENT or at most a soft loop: conditional ask ('tell me only if it is not detailed enough'); weight-of-intention says a soft conditional ask opens no card.

cases.context: incoming reply that delivers what the owner asked for (a detailed process description, several paragraphs follow)
cases.text: להלן תיאור תהליך תאום הפגישה של עובד חדש:
cases.label: CLOSE
cases.expected: CLOSE the owner's Waiting-on loop for rm-008: the requested detailed explanation was delivered in the body.

cases.context: owner's reply
cases.text: תודה רבה על הפירוט, הוא ברור ומספיק לנו כדי להתחיל לבנות את ההדגמה על תהליך תאום הפגישה של עובד חדש.
cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: Answers rm-004 (closes it if it was opened). No new ask.

cases.context: owner's reply
cases.text: נעדכן כשההדגמה מוכנה ונתאם מולכם מועד להציג אותה.
cases.label: PROMISE
cases.expected: PROMISE: open a 'You promised' loop (update when the demo is ready and schedule a date), no fixed date.

cases.context: owner's earlier ask in the same thread
cases.text: נודה לקבל הסבר מפורט של התהליך על מנת שנוכל למדל אותו ולבנות את הפיילוט לקראת הפגישה.
cases.label: ASK
cases.expected: ASK: open a Waiting-on loop.
cases.note: sent before 2026-10-05; included as the anchor for rm-001 and rm-005

cases.context: incoming forward to two colleagues with the owner in Cc; new body is only a signature, the rest is the owner's own quoted outreach (which contains the ask in rm-010)
cases.text: [NAME] מנהל חטיבת שירות טלפון: [EMAIL]
cases.label: HOLD
cases.expected: SILENT: no ask of the owner (the quoted ask is the owner's own words and must not be read as incoming). The owner's original Waiting-on loop stays OPEN: a forward is not an answer.
